analyst_view.overall: Celta Fortuna (17th, 13 pts, 26 conceded, no win in their last five) host Valladolid (12th, 18 pts) at Balaídos; Fredi Álvarez's reserve side sit just above the relegation places and usually play reactively (32% possession in a 5-1 loss at Girona). Valladolid miss Thiago Ojeda (fifth yellow, confirmed by the RFEF), Latasa and Guille Bueno; Celta Fortuna miss Gavián (injured in the 2-2 with Córdoba) and Sarppong; all of these are in the numbers. Both squads are heavily booked (Celta 42 yellows, Valladolid 41 yellows and 4 reds). News for this match was thin: I found no preview with team news after a real search, so the view rests on the league page, the suspension list and recent match reports, and no referee is named.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, already taking off Latasa (Valladolid's 10% of goal involvement) and Sarppong, and adding Valladolid's hot scoring run (14 in six). Celta Fortuna's leaky defence (26 conceded) and Álvaro Marín's 8 goals are in their record, and I found no new absences, so I stay at 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners and already add Valladolid's recent corner surge (+11% momentum), with Celta Fortuna winning few (17 in six). Celta's reserve side tends to sit deep and clear the ball, which is what those figures show, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.5 cards: both teams are among the most booked in the division and Celta Fortuna's recent booking rate is already added (+8%). Valladolid lose Ojeda to a fifth yellow, and the referee is not named yet, so there is nothing the numbers can't see: I stay at 6.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.7 shots, already lifted by Valladolid's high recent volume (+13%) and Celta Fortuna conceding many shots (99 in six). Without Latasa, Valladolid lean on Arnu (5 goals) and Ponceau's creativity, which the numbers partly account for; I stay at 27.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target, already up for Valladolid's sharp recent finishing (+15% momentum). I found no lineup news to change either side's attack, so I stay at 9.9.
